This is baseline truthful messaging, not evidence of fabricated threats.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"Ramadan: President Tinubu Appeals to Nigerians to Pray for Peace, Stability","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"March 12, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/ramadan-president-tinubu-appeals-to-nigerians-to-pray-for-peace-stability/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged kidnapping, banditry, and other real threats while urging peace and mutual support. This supports truthful public explanation rather than fearmongering.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Receives U.S Ambassador, Underscores Importance of Sustaining Democracy, Its Norms and Institutions","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"July 25, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-receives-u-s-ambassador-underscores-importance-of-sustaining-democracy-its-norms-and-institutions/","summary":"Tinubu said protests are part of democracy but the government will not condone demonstrations that destroy lives and property. This is indirect but relevant evidence of fear amplification before protests even began.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]}]}
